entities.summary: Robert Thomas Woods is an American professional football coach and former player who is the assistant wide receivers coach for the Los Angeles Rams in the National Football League (NFL). He played 12 seasons as a wide receiver in the NFL. He played college football for the USC Trojans, earning consensus All-American honors in 2011. Woods was selected by the Buffalo Bills in the second round of the 2013 NFL draft. He signed with the Rams in 2017, winning Super Bowl LVI. Woods was also a member of the Tennessee Titans, Houston Texans, and Pittsburgh Steelers.
